item.text:
No. Although Postgres uses the same `Pipeline` and `QueryEngine` interfaces as Vespa, it does not derive query scope from `RetrievalContext` (or `IngestContext`). In particular, it does not automatically apply Vespa’s `group_id` or `yql_filter`; queries can see the full collection.

For tenant isolation, use separate collections/tables or apply filtering before querying the Postgres store.

[Mistral Docs: Postgres backend](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index/postgres)  
[Mistral Docs: Search index backends](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit/search-index)
